meta.name: All Things Fair
meta.description: In 1943 Malmö, 15-year-old Stig is attracted to his teacher Viola, 22 years his senior, who, drawn to his youth and innocence, believes the lad is a God-sent relief from her miserable marriage to a drunken, unfaithful lout.
meta.slogan: He was a student. She was his teacher. Their love was forbidden.
